import { MeshBasicNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, vec2, vec3, mix, smoothstep, fract, sin } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry, Color } = ctx.THREE;
  const group = new Group();

  // Colors
  const inkColor = new Color('#16161d');
  const surfaceColor = new Color('#0b0b10');
  const accentColor = new Color('#ff2a38');

  // Stage / Backdrop (7x6 at z=-2.5) to satisfy the visual Spec requirement & avoid dark voids
  const backdropGeo = new PlaneGeometry(8.5, 6.5);
  const backdropMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();

  const uvs = uv();
  const gradFactor = uvs.y;

  // Pseudo-random premium grain pattern
  const noise = fract(sin(uvs.x.mul(12345.0).add(uvs.y.mul(67890.0))).mul(43758.5453));
  const grain = noise.mul(0.025);

  // Smooth gradient transition
  const baseGrad = mix(
    vec3(surfaceColor.r, surfaceColor.g, surfaceColor.b),
    vec3(inkColor.r, inkColor.g, inkColor.b),
    gradFactor
  );

  // Subtle accent ambient glow at the bottom corner
  const distFromSpot = uvs.sub(vec2(0.8, 0.2)).length();
  const spotGlow = smoothstep(0.7, 0.0, distFromSpot).mul(0.12);
  const finalColor = baseGrad.add(vec3(accentColor.r, accentColor.g, accentColor.b).mul(spotGlow)).add(vec3(grain));

  backdropMat.colorNode = finalColor;
  const backdrop = new Mesh(backdropGeo, backdropMat);
  backdrop.position.set(0, 0, -2.5);
  group.add(backdrop);

  // Main Card textured plane
  const cardGeo = new PlaneGeometry(4.0, 2.5);
  const cardMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ transparent: true });
  const cardMesh = new Mesh(cardGeo, cardMat);
  cardMesh.position.set(0, 0, 0);
  group.add(cardMesh);

  // Load Image Asset dynamically
  const imageUrl = config.imageUrl ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.imageUrl;
  if (imageUrl) {
    ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(imageUrl).then((texture) => {
      cardMat.map = texture;
      cardMat.needsUpdate = true;
    });
  }

  // Gentle premium floating/breathing animation
  const tl = gsap.timeline({ repeat: -1, yoyo: true });
  tl.to(cardMesh.position, {
    y: 0.06,
    x: 0.02,
    duration: 4.0,
    ease: 'power1.inOut'
  });

  // Apply primitives
  const activePrimitives = [];
  const primitivesList = config.cinematicPrimitives ?? [];
  for (const prim of primitivesList) {
    if (ctx.primitives[prim.name]) {
      const res = ctx.primitives[prim.name](group, prim.params);
      activePrimitives.push(res);
    }
  }

  // Self-contained cleanup
  group.userData = {
    cleanup() {
      tl.kill();
      backdropGeo.dispose();
      backdropMat.dispose();
      cardGeo.dispose();
      cardMat.dispose();
      activePrimitives.forEach((p) => {
        if (p && typeof p.cleanup === 'function') {
          p.cleanup();
        }
      });
    }
  };

  return group;
}
